message.content: On the jam session scheduled for April 5th, 2026 (20260405), Li Hua suggests playing "Viva la Vida" by Coldplay. This song is highlighted as being a fun choice and one that the group members look forward to playing together. Li Hua also mentions that they might need to prepare by practicing the timing, as Wolfgang Schulz suggests listening to the track beforehand to get a feel for the rhythm.
